title: Sparkly glasses
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='lensL' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#b8f0ff'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#5fd4f0'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#2ab8d8'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='lensR' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#b8f0ff'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#5fd4f0'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#2ab8d8'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='frameGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffd76e'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e8a020'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Left lens -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='52' rx='19' ry='17' fill='url(#lensL)' stroke='url(#frameGrad)' stroke-width='4'/>
  <!-- Right lens -->
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='52' rx='19' ry='17' fill='url(#lensR)' stroke='url(#frameGrad)' stroke-width='4'/>

  <!-- Bridge -->
  <path d='M 51 50 Q 50 44 49 50' fill='none' stroke='url(#frameGrad)' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M 49.5 48 Q 50 42 50.5 48' fill='none' stroke='#ffd76e' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Left temple arm -->
  <path d='M 13 46 Q 6 42 4 50' fill='none' stroke='#e8a020' stroke-width='3.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M 13 46 Q 6 42 4 50' fill='none' stroke='#ffd76e' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Right temple arm -->
  <path d='M 87 46 Q 94 42 96 50' fill='none' stroke='#e8a020' stroke-width='3.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M 87 46 Q 94 42 96 50' fill='none' stroke='#ffd76e' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Glare on left lens -->
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='44' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.55' transform='rotate(-25 26 44)'/>
  <ellipse cx='24' cy='42' rx='2.5' ry='1.5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.7' transform='rotate(-25 24 42)'/>

  <!-- Glare on right lens -->
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='44' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.55' transform='rotate(-25 62 44)'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='42' rx='2.5' ry='1.5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.7' transform='rotate(-25 60 42)'/>

  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <!-- top-left sparkle -->
  <g transform='translate(14,26)'>
    <path d='M 0,-7 L 1.8,-1.8 L 7,0 L 1.8,1.8 L 0,7 L -1.8,1.8 L -7,0 L -1.8,-1.8 Z' fill='#ffe873'/>
    <circle cx='0' cy='0' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  </g>

  <!-- top-right sparkle -->
  <g transform='translate(84,22)'>
    <path d='M 0,-6 L 1.5,-1.5 L 6,0 L 1.5,1.5 L 0,6 L -1.5,1.5 L -6,0 L -1.5,-1.5 Z' fill='#fff0a0'/>
    <circle cx='0' cy='0' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  </g>

  <!-- left sparkle -->
  <g transform='translate(8,68)'>
    <path d='M 0,-5 L 1.2,-1.2 L 5,0 L 1.2,1.2 L 0,5 L -1.2,1.2 L -5,0 L -1.2,-1.2 Z' fill='#ffd76e'/>
    <circle cx='0' cy='0' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  </g>

  <!-- right sparkle -->
  <g transform='translate(91,64)'>
    <path d='M 0,-5.5 L 1.3,-1.3 L 5.5,0 L 1.3,1.3 L 0,5.5 L -1.3,1.3 L -5.5,0 L -1.3,-1.3 Z' fill='#ffe873'/>
    <circle cx='0' cy='0' r='1.1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  </g>

  <!-- bottom sparkle -->
  <g transform='translate(50,82)'>
    <path d='M 0,-5 L 1.2,-1.2 L 5,0 L 1.2,1.2 L 0,5 L -1.2,1.2 L -5,0 L -1.2,-1.2 Z' fill='#fff0a0'/>
    <circle cx='0' cy='0' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  </g>

  <!-- small sparkle near left lens -->
  <g transform='translate(20,72)'>
    <path d='M 0,-3 L 0.8,-0.8 L 3,0 L 0.8,0.8 L 0,3 L -0.8,0.8 L -3,0 L -0.8,-0.8 Z' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.9'/>
  </g>

  <!-- small sparkle near right lens -->
  <g transform='translate(78,36)'>
    <path d='M 0,-3.2 L 0.9,-0.9 L 3.2,0 L 0.9,0.9 L 0,3.2 L -0.9,0.9 L -3.2,0 L -0.9,-0.9 Z' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.9'/>
  </g>

  <!-- tiny dot sparkles -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='24' r='1.2' fill='#ffe873'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='78' r='1.2' fill='#ffd76e'/>
</svg>
